counting_policy: Append-only operational attempt numbers end at 149. Statistical inference uses an effective count of 200: every reconstructed formula, eligible control, aborted or consumed replay counts, plus a 51-cell reserve for any scratch variants whose exact commands were not retained.

blocks.evidence_boundary: The exploratory shell commands were not retained as a durable per-variant ledger. Eighteen cells were reconstructed from the six inspected formula families plus their inspected cadence and rebalance-band variants. Any reconstruction error or additional scratch cell is charged again through the separate 51-cell inferential reserve; none is eligible to be called preregistered.
All twelve inspected target, gross-cap, and cadence cells count. Development, validation, recent, and anchor outcomes were seen before Attempt149, so no ETF-panel interval is an untouched holdout.

blocks.diagnostic_and_comparator_counting_bound: Mapping B and the four comparators were fixed before industry outcomes and cannot select, rescue, reverse, or modify primary A. They are not additional selection-eligible candidates; the 51-cell inferential reserve nevertheless overcharges any ambiguity.

inferential_multiplicity_reserve.reason: Upper-bound reserve for unretained formula, target, cap, cadence, band, and rerun cells beyond the 149 operational attempts.

claim_boundary: The 200-trial inferential count deliberately over-credits incomplete scratch history to the multiplicity penalty. It prevents the selected volatility-managed G4 formula from being represented as an untouched discovery and does not convert the new industry replay into live, forward, tradable-ETF, or options evidence.
